survivingClaim: PROVED (elementary, checked by a second agent; novelty unchecked): 1/(64 * 2^Omega_N * N^2) <= lam_min(G_N) <= (3 + log N)/(N-1)^2 for the Vasyunin Gram matrix, so lam_min >= A_p N^-p holds for every p > 2 and for no p < 2; p = 2 is open. This settles the open lemma vasyunin-lammin-uniform-lower-bound in the form p = 2 + eps. MEASURED (N <= 2000): the same law (exponents -1.91 to -1.94) for zeta, four characters mod 3/4/5, DH and two periodic sequences with neither Euler product nor functional equation.
obstruction: lam_min(G_N) is a mean-value quantity fixed by the 1/|s|^2 weight: the same N^-2 law holds for DH and for sequences with no arithmetic structure, and it bounds only the size of the optimal coefficients, not the distance d_N. The period-function recursion on Gram entries restates classical formulas and adds no zero information; no transfer-operator compression found (non-existence not proved). Stops at rows P14/P15.
controlsThatDefeat: DH: same lam_min law (exponent -1.928); DH floor 8.4e-5 invisible at N <= 2000
four Dirichlet characters and two periodic sequences without Euler product or functional equation: same law
lesson: Do not use lam_min of Nyman-Beurling Gram matrices as a zero detector. Phi(u) = u A(1) - sum_{m<=u}(1*a)(m) gives the eigenvalue bounds in a few lines.
refereeNote: No error in any PROVED step; Lemmas 2 and 3 are restatements of classical formulas.
